name: claude-codex-workflow
description: Claude plans or implements, Codex implements, and a background Claude run checks and fixes Codex's work. Playwright, graphify, Impeccable and caveman are wired in for both agents.

plugins.name: claude-codex-workflow
plugins.description: Set up the Claude + Codex workflow in any project with one command (/claude-codex-workflow:setup installs Claude Code, Codex CLI, Playwright, graphify and Impeccable). Claude plans; one pasted line has Codex run every phase with background Claude verification.
